name: agent-lens
description: Observe local coding agent activity in VS Code.

agentLens.agents.markdownDescription: Local source settings keyed by `claude-code` or `codex`. Each can set `enabled`, an observation-only `logRoot`, and additional `profiles` with `id`, `label`, and `home`.

agentLens.privateDisplay.markdownDescription: Hide prompts, commands, command output, diffs and transcript links in Agent Lens views.

agentLens.signals.loopThreshold.markdownDescription: Consecutive identical tool calls in one agent lane before Agent Lens shows a Possible loop. Polling calls count only while their result stays the same.

agentLens.signals.checkIgnore.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for files whose edits do not need a check. Edits that match are ignored when Agent Lens decides whether a turn finished without checks.

agentLens.signals.checkCommands.markdownDescription: Extra command patterns that count as a check, keyed by project root path or `*` for every project. A value is a list of regular expressions, or `{ "replace": true, "patterns": [...] }` to replace the built-in patterns for that root. Patterns are matched as text against the recorded command. Nothing is run, and patterns are never read from repository files.

agentLens.context.warnPercent.markdownDescription: Context fill percentage where the level becomes High. It must be lower than the Critical percentage, or both return to their defaults.

agentLens.context.criticalPercent.markdownDescription: Context fill percentage where the level becomes Critical.

agentLens.context.alerts.markdownDescription: Show a notification when a live session first reaches High or Critical context. One alert per session, lane, level and compaction. Off by default.
